about_short_description.short_description: Ashby develops human resource software to assist companies with hiring and manpower management.

product.name: Ashby All-in-one Recruiting Platform
product.description: An integrated recruiting software combining ATS, scheduling, CRM, sourcing, and analytics to manage hiring processes for companies of all sizes.

product.name: Ashby Analytics
product.description: A recruiting analytics tool that provides customizable reports, dashboards, and insights to track hiring metrics and support data-driven decisions.

product.name: Ashby Sourcing & CRM
product.description: A sourcing and candidate relationship management tool that helps recruiters find, engage, and track candidates using search, outreach sequences, and AI assistance.

product.name: Ashby Scheduling
product.description: A scheduling tool that automates interview booking, manages complex calendars, and provides self-serve booking links to streamline candidate and interviewer coordination.

product.name: Ashby AI Notetaker (Upcoming)
product.description: An AI-powered tool that automatically records, transcribes, and summarizes interview calls, integrating notes directly into Ashby workflows.

product.name: Ashby AI Interviewer
product.description: An AI-driven interviewing tool embedded in Ashby that runs structured screening conversations and feeds results into hiring workflows.
